commits_data.title: pcapng: Const-ify custom block handler registrations.
commits_data.message:
pcapng: Const-ify custom block handler registrations.

The pcapng_custom_block_enterprise_handler_t structure is presently only ever
read, so let's make them read-only.

We can un-"const" them if we later find that there's need.
